verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage documents case management for reviewing risk alerts raised during ongoing monitoring, in the Mesh app or via the API. Cases also expose an audit log trail. Together these let an analyst open and inspect a new monitoring alert and its risks. However, nothing in the evidence shows a view of what actually changed, such as a diff of new versus previous profile or list data. missing for 10: explicit documentation of change/delta details on monitoring alerts (e.g. new vs. prior hit data, updated profile fields), evidence that the audit trail covers data changes rather than case actions, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
